title: Perfluorohexyloctane ophthalmic
overview: Perfluorohexyloctane ophthalmic solution is used to treat signs and symptoms of dry eye disease (a condition where tears aren't able to provide adequate moisture for your eyes). Perfluorohexyloctane is in a class of medications called semifluorinated alkanes. It works by providing a film layer on the eye to prevent tears and moisture from evaporating.

sections.Before using perfluorohexyloctane ophtha: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to perfluorohexyloctane, any other medications, or any of the ingredients in perfluorohexyloctane ophthalmic solution. Ask your pharmacist for a list of the ingredients.tell your doctor and pharmacist what prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are taking or plan to take.tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. If you become pregnant while using perfluorohexyloctane, call your doctor.
